sentences.text: A third bearing checks the other two.
Because of small errors, three bearings rarely meet at exactly one point.
Instead, they form a small triangle, called a cocked hat.
Plot your fix in the middle of the triangle.
If the triangle is large, something is wrong: a misidentified landmark, a misread compass, a bearing plotted from the wrong side, or a forgotten correction.
The ideal is three objects about one hundred twenty degrees apart.
